description:
Crew Air tells an outdoor crew in California what today's shift looks like under the wildfire smoke rule (Cal/OSHA §5141.1) and the heat rule (§3395): the hour the air crosses AQI 151 and N95s have to be on hand, the hour shade and water are due, and the cleanest hours for heavy work.

For crew leads, foremen, farm and construction supervisors, landscapers, utility and road crews, and the workers on those crews. Free, no account, no sign-up.

PLAN
One card in the colour of the day's worst air: the peak AQI and the first rule that kicks in, as a sentence. Heat and heavy-work tiles, air by the hour, and the nearest satellite fire with its distance and direction. The AQI is a NowCast, the same measure the rule uses, checked against the nearest AirNow monitor when one is close. A Record line says how the number was determined and which rule is in force, so a lead has something to write down.

CHECK THE SKY
Point the camera at the horizon: the nearest fire and the nearest air monitor sit on their compass bearings. Take a photo, or pick one, and a vision model says whether it shows smoke or haze and whether it looks worse than the forecast. If it does, report it in one tap.

REPORT
Four kinds a worker can send without typing: smoke or haze, someone feels sick, no shade or water, no N95s here. The crew lead sees it on the same site's page with the forecast, the nearest fire and the nearest monitor attached, and marks it fixed. No name needed. Take it further: a draft Cal/OSHA complaint from the report.

PRINT
The briefing sheet for the shift opens on airsignal.app, ready to print or save as PDF for the toolbox talk.

WHAT THE NUMBERS ARE
Forecast from Open-Meteo, ground readings from EPA AirNow, fire detections from NASA FIRMS (VIIRS), alerts from the National Weather Service. Rules from Cal/OSHA Title 8 §5141.1 and §3395. California only for now.

PRIVACY
No account. The place you plan for is sent to fetch the forecast. A sky photo is sent once to TypeSafe for analysis and is not stored by us; faces are blacked out on the phone before it leaves. A report carries your rounded location only if you allow it. The app keeps a small usage counter of our own with an install code that is deleted with the app. Full policy at airsignal.app/crew/privacy.

Crew Air is a planning aid, not legal advice. The rule still requires the employer's own determination.
promotionalText: The hour the smoke rule starts, the hour shade is due, where the fire is. For California crews, free, no account.
whatsNew: First release: the shift plan under Cal/OSHA §5141.1 and §3395, the sky check with the camera, and reports to the crew lead.
